organizations.title: Organisations
organizations.subtitle: Choose where to work, or start another one.
organizations.emptyBody: You are not in an organisation yet. Create one to start adding documents.
organizations.createBody: You become its owner. The address is made from the name.
organizations.nameHint: Your company or team. You can invite people afterwards.
organizations.createFailed: That organisation could not be created. Try again.
organizations.addressFixed: The address stays /{slug}, so links people already have keep working.
organizations.renameFailed: That name could not be saved. Try again.
organizations.membersBody: You are {role} here. You can only act on people at or below your own level.
organizations.membersCaption: Members of this organisation and their roles
organizations.membersUnavailable: The member list could not be loaded.
organizations.memberActionFailed: That change could not be made. Try again.
organizations.leaveBody: You lose access to everything in it. Someone can invite you back.
organizations.lastOwner: An organisation must keep at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
organizations.deleteBody: Everything in it goes, for everyone, and it cannot be undone.

landing.title: Document intelligence for teams
landing.description: Upload documents, search them semantically, and ask questions that come back with citations. This page is a placeholder until task 14.1.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The application frame. Documents, search and the assistant arrive in phases 5 to 7; this route exists so they have somewhere to land.

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDescription: Upload a PDF, Word file or plain text and it will be processed, chunked and made searchable.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.emptyDescription: Ask a question about your documents and the answer comes back with the passages it came from.

usage.title: Usage
usage.emptyDescription: Token consumption and AI cost appear here once the workspace starts processing documents.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyDescription: Create an organisation to invite members, assign roles and control who can see which documents.

states.errorDescription: This could not be loaded. Trying again is often enough.

errors.pageTitle: This page could not be loaded
errors.pageDescription: The problem has been recorded. Trying again is often enough.
errors.notFoundDescription: This address does not match anything in the workspace. It may have been moved, or the link may be out of date.

auth.signUpSubtitle: Start with your documents in a few minutes.
auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
auth.resetSubtitle: We will send a link to your email address.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.registered: Check your email to finish setting up your account.
auth.failed: That email address and password do not match an account.
auth.unavailable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
